description: Panasonic DML LX3 digital camera: R, G and B spectral responses measured with a set of interference filters (camSPECS) in C. Mauer's 2009 diploma thesis (Cologne University of Applied Sciences / Image Engineering), appendix 'Panasonic DMC-LX3'.
facility_description: Digital cameras (DSLRs, mirrorless, compact, industrial, cinema and phone cameras) whose RGB channel spectral sensitivities or internal IR/UV-cut filter transmissions have been measured.
notes: SVO gives no ProfileReference for this camera; attribution to Mauer (2009) is by camera match: the thesis appendix contains a 'Panasonic DMC-LX3' section. NJM values look digitized from the thesis plots (quantized steps), not copied from its tables; not numerically verified. Licence: no licence statement found on the TH Koeln repository front page or in the thesis; looked at https://epb.bibl.th-koeln.de/frontdoor/index/index/docId/166.

licence.scope: Diploma thesis record; no licence named.
